newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen mixed ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen mixed ahead of weekend.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to remain mixed on Friday amid lacklustre trading when the market reopens after a religious holiday on Thursday.
Dealers said investors and institutions would be on the sidelines ahead of the Saturday-Sunday weekend.
"Sentiment is depressed after the default of two brokers this month," dealer Rony Byramjee said. "There is lot of uncertainty among investors and the index is likely to slip."
On Wednesday, the Karachi 100-index fell 2.03 points, or 0.13 percent, to 1,579.49 amid 185 losers and 91 gainers.
